task: 秘密排列更新随机带的可行性与分离审查

overall.summary_zh: 冻结的源钥匙/完整token持有outgoing秘密种子的PRP包装，能够在已有GP23/CTX1完整UE-R基底前提下精确保持全部自适应视图和有限失败。未包装同目标基线已有相同安全性且成本更低。普通PRF替代有合法公开种子反例，仅Upd侧包装的无条件通用升级也有EncLeak反例。未得到新的完整协议增量或严格资源分离。

candidate_spec.base: UNIUE-GP23-EG-CTX1 / SELECT-FAIR-B-SPEC2; C0 counterpart separately preserved
candidate_spec.base_security: Project DDH-based full ordinary-tape theorem with actual informed review provenance; not claimed as verbatim published SPEC2 theorem

blocks_linear_action_learning.RNG_INPUT: Removes the direct old decoder from rho to effective coefficients while critical seed hidden; no generic proof that all coefficient recovery or attacks become hard.
blocks_linear_action_learning.EFFECTIVE: No. Exposed effective words/coefficients preserve the learned base action. A publicly sampled base pool gives a law-equivalent local wrapper output without needing its secret raw-input preimage.
blocks_linear_action_learning.GP_control: Chosen GP base already lies outside the established low-dimensional public ring-feature class.

complete_target_security.frozen_GP_case: Exact preservation from an already UE-R-secure base, including all legal adaptive histories and named finite failure rules.
complete_target_security.only_original_game_base: Universal update-only upgrade is refuted. Restricted matrix compiler lacks exact ordinary-response opening and possibly Enc opening safety.
complete_target_security.ordinary_PRF: Standard PRF security alone is insufficient when seed is disclosed.

three_questions.increment_over_mature_baseline: None established. Bare GP meets same target with smaller token/key/state/randomness/update cost; FMM exact model remains unresolved but is not needed for this coverage.

findings.conclusion: Current task is informed, no agents or independent review launched. ROUND007 phase1 blind derivation and phase2 informed joint supplement are separately retained. GP review directory actually records same-session informed review.
Source key and complete token carry sigma_j. Future Key3 reveals sigma4, not sigma3. Adjacent full-key token recovery and backward key recovery preserve original closure rules.
For every fixed sigma and context, Pi_sigma(U)=U. Decoded base coefficient joint law and sampling failure law are preserved; not claiming independence after conditioning on current rho.

findings.evidence_grade: Informed general proof plus stopped-word finite check
premises: Efficient completion of unused uniformly random slots
findings.losses: No additional hybrid/epoch/failure loss; reduction runtime includes inverse permutation, completion and seeds.

findings.conclusion: Sigma fixed from initial generation; rho=Pi_sigma^-1(completed base tape) explains every prior ordinary response. No programmable key or random oracle used in this preservation theorem.

Hidden persistent keys allow ordinary PRP oracle hybrids with sum_j delta_PRP,j; inverse-oracle reductions need corresponding strong-PRP. Ideal permutation/function comparison pays at most binom(v,2)/2^M for distinct inputs; not a delayed-key theorem.

findings.evidence_grade: Explicit secure-family hybrid and legal challenge
findings.construction: F(x)=(G1(x),P(0||G2(x))) with optional dummy fourth key
findings.gap: 1/2 in no-failure model; >=1/2-nu0-nu1 in finite model
findings.later_disclosure_variant: Move CorrToken2 after challenge; old nonce still testable

findings.evidence_grade: Security-preserving base augmentation and four-query legal attack
findings.construction: Encplus=(Enc0, tau XOR encode(K)), Updplus appends independent uniform string, Dec ignores string. Original game unchanged in observable law, EncLeak reveals K.
findings.scope: Any update-only Derive; Enc not modified

findings.conclusion: Hidden-boundary base O.Upd gives Cprime without omega; inverse permutation cannot produce honest rho. Fresh output simulation alone does not supply conditional update coins. Requires an extra opening/programmability property and complete later-key proof.

Projection to base ciphertext/effective ordinary words has the same law. Sample base effective pool locally; its wrapper preimage exists and has the right law though unknown. Base action-learning output remains a correctly distributed wrapper update; no oracle raw input is required.

findings.evidence_grade: Known original-game result and exact unchanged distribution
findings.conclusion: Per-key permutation does not repair FI-v4. Enc0,Next1,CorrToken1,Chall1 remains legal, Kstar empty; support-test gap alpha-beta_real and known lower bounds persist.

Independent uniform input collisions preserved, same parent/same rho gives same output. Forced challenge-input replay can yield equality attack, but is a stronger RNG-control contract outside current iid game. Atomic C0/FAIR outcomes and no partial FAIL tapes retained.

RNG-INPUT/W1 returns actual fresh rho but is a new schema; it does not silently satisfy literal base SPEC2 effective sampler-word exposure. EFFECTIVE returns required effective words too and offers no such coefficient hiding. Real diagnostic contract is unconfirmed.

findings.evidence_grade: Matching fixed-model proof and scalar cost dominance
findings.auxiliary_costs: Key/seed/state and permutation/pool input costs added; ciphertext/update-count unchanged
findings.scope: Current DDH group candidate. No rejection of every possible future post-quantum matrix compiler.

findings.evidence_grade: Primary partial text and full primitive definition reading
findings.conclusion: FMM PRF derivation/state-resource patterns are established in read excerpts; full exact SELECT compiler theorem not verified. PRP/enciphering primitives mature. Coverage here rests on bare same-target GP and self-contained preservation, not missing-source novelty.
ONLINE_TRUSTED_STATE_V1 operation_limit null. Full effective-coin logging, token isolation, later corruption and RNG rollback need explicit contracts; native AS/RP revocation unchanged.
